function.name: get_well_status
function.description: Assess current producing status from latest inspection thermal delta vs operating manual threshold. Flags stale status if recorded active but thermal reading indicates well is down.

function.name: get_down_wells_in_area
function.description: List all wells in a geographic area or block (e.g. 'Northeast Block 8') that are currently not producing oil, along with delta above air, recorded status, and reasons.

function.name: get_well_temp_timeseries
function.description: Weekly wellhead vs ambient temperature history for a well over N weeks with non-producing intervals marked.

function.name: get_well_spills_history
function.description: Get confirmed spill history and total volume for a well, with rainwater/mud false positives excluded under SOP-SR Section 7.

function.name: get_well_downtime_in_year
function.description: Calculate downtime days (exactly 7 days per non-producing inspection) and failure causes for a well in a year.

function.name: get_top_downtime_wells
function.description: Rank top wells in an area by cumulative downtime days over a given window.

function.name: get_area_spills_map
function.description: Retrieve GPS coordinates, spill volumes, and dates for recent spills in an area for Leaflet mapping.

function.name: get_spills_heatmap
function.description: Generate a 2D matrix distribution of crude releases by area and calendar month.
